pairs.subject: metric-forecasting
pairs.evidence: src/lib/maturity/forecast.ts:170 The fit averages observations by calendar day but anchors projections to the last raw reading, allowing one reading to shift the forecast away from the fitted daily series.

techniques.evidence: src/lib/maturity/forecast.ts:167 R² is computed and returned for two-day fits; lowData flags the problem but does not structurally withhold the numeric field.
src/lib/maturity/forecast.ts:341 Goal ETA computation accepts any positive slope, including slopes classified as flat by the shared weekly band, rather than skipping the crossing solve.
src/lib/maturity/forecast.ts:360 The verdict compares the crossing date with the deadline, but projectGoal computes no separate current-position verdict against a baseline-to-deadline target line.
src/lib/maturity/forecast.ts:329 The count-and-span gate runs after forecastTrajectory has computed slope, confidence, projection and level ETA, contrary to the required gate-before-fit ordering.

src/lib/maturity/forecast.ts:217 Past crossings and beyond-horizon crossings collapse into the same null result instead of distinct explanatory states; a past crossing does not report the required contradiction between fit and observation.
src/lib/maturity/forecast.ts:170 Elapsed-day OLS and daily means are implemented, but the ray uses the last raw reading instead of the last day's collapsed mean.
